description: One manifest per video. Scene order, durations, render settings, and run metadata. A 30-second video is a short manifest; a 2-hour video is a long one. Same architecture.

animation_model.description: Which model wrote the animation code, as named by the operator. Model-agnostic: record the actual choice, never assume.

brand_bible.description: Path to the brand bible markdown file used for this run.

fps.description: Frames per second. 30 for final, 15 for previews.

music_bed.description: Path to the music bed audio file, laid over the final assembly only.

scenes.description: In play order. Each scene renders independently.

duration_seconds.description: Set by audio-first timing: the measured voiceover chunk duration. Minimum 1.

sfx_events.description: Beat-synced sound events: {at_seconds, sound} referencing the sfx map.

voiceover_text.description: The exact script text for this scene's TTS chunk, 2000 to 4000 chars, never cut mid-sentence.

segment_minutes.description: 5 is the standard. 15 only when preflight certifies strong hardware.

sfx.description: Named UI sound files keyed by event: click, whoosh, thump. Beat-synced in assembly.

storage_root.description: Resolved per environment. Mac: ~/Downloads/openclaw-master-files/motion-videos. Docker VPS: a persistent volume such as /data/motion-videos.

model.description: Default s2.1-pro. drama-3-preview is opt-in only, with served-model verification.

reference_id.description: Fish Audio voice reference id. Same id on every chunk request.

video_name.description: Folder name under the storage root. Lowercase, hyphens, no spaces.

title: Motion Video Plus run manifest
